findings.officialRetailRule: Each E.Leclerc centre freely defines its Charge E-Lec tariff; the price is displayed before charging.
findings.nationalStandardPromotion: 0.19 EUR/kWh applies to standard charging only; rapid and ultra-rapid charging are excluded.
findings.technicalOperator: Freshmile manages/supervises the Charge E-Lec application and charging infrastructure for SIPLEC.
findings.publicWebApp: https://app.charge-elec.leclerc/ is a SIPLEC/Freshmile application surface; crawler access does not expose station tariff objects.

publicGuestQrLead.officialFreshmileEvidence: Freshmile still documents XFM links as a no-account guest route that opens the charging-point page and allows charging. Freshmile also states the applicable tariff and minimum payment requirement are shown before charging.
publicGuestQrLead.chargeElecCompatibilityEvidence: Official Charge E-Lec station pages expose five-character point codes such as AFGQ2 and SCWV2, matching the historical/current Freshmile XFM code shape.
publicGuestQrLead.blockingPoint: The analysis web environment cannot currently resolve/follow xfm.fr/<Charge E-Lec point code> to its final public page, so the returned tariff and tenant identity cannot yet be verified.
publicGuestQrLead.tccPolicy: Do not ingest until a resolved guest page proves the displayed price belongs to Charge E-Lec/SIPLEC for FR*LE2 rather than a generic Freshmile mobility tariff.

evidence: Historical website telemetry for app.charge-elec.leclerc reports chg.leclerc as a redirecting source.
The .leclerc registry report shows chg.leclerc is an active Cloudflare-backed domain in August 2026.
chg.leclerc first appeared in public new-domain reporting in April 2025, during Charge E-Lec development.
leclercShortDomainLead.hypothesis: chg.leclerc may be the SIPLEC-owned short/deep-link domain used by Charge E-Lec, potentially preferable to xfm.fr for proving direct-retail tenant context.
leclercShortDomainLead.blockingPoint: No indexed public path pattern or resolvable point-code deep link has yet been found.

freshmileBackendLead.evidence: Historical Freshmile mobile traffic capture shows map/search requests returning charging-station information through this endpoint.
freshmileBackendLead.currentFreshmileWebMapStatus: The former charge.freshmile.com/map web surface now redirects to an app-migration landing page, while Freshmile support documentation still describes XFM/QR guest charging and tariff display.
freshmileBackendLead.tccPolicy: Do not import prices from the generic Freshmile endpoint until it is proven that the returned tariff for FR*LE2 is the SIPLEC Charge E-Lec direct retail tariff, not a Freshmile EMP/roaming tariff.

historicalPilotLead.evidence: Public reporting in October 2025 states that the beta site exposed the station map and prices, varying from 0.25 to 0.45 EUR/kWh depending on charging power.
historicalPilotLead.currentUse: Architecture/route discovery only; historical prices must never be applied to current DC stations.

application.reason: APK metadata is public, but the APK/XAPK bytes could not be retrieved in the available analysis environment.
application.safeStaticAnalysisGoal: If public APK bytes become available, extract only embedded public API base URLs, tenant identifiers, deep-link domains and route names; do not bypass authentication or security controls.

authoritativePhysicalSources: National IRVE static dataset filtered on operator FR*LE2

secondaryEvidencePolicy.communityAppObservations: May be retained with timestamp for research/cross-checking only.
secondaryEvidencePolicy.aggregatorTariffs: May be used only as cross-checks, never as authoritative Charge E-Lec direct prices.
secondaryEvidencePolicy.historicalBetaTariffs: Architecture evidence only; never current production tariffs.

safeRoutesRemaining.goal: Resolve xfm.fr/<FR*LE2 point code> to the public guest page and verify whether the tariff is Charge E-Lec/SIPLEC direct retail.
safeRoutesRemaining.constraint: Public guest flow only; no authentication bypass.

safeRoutesRemaining.goal: Determine whether chg.leclerc supports station/point deep links and whether those pages expose the direct Charge E-Lec tariff.
Extract public API/deep-link configuration embedded in the Charge E-Lec Android package.
safeRoutesRemaining.constraint: Requires obtaining APK/XAPK bytes from a lawful public source; no bypass of authentication or security controls.

safeRoutesRemaining.goal: Observe the tariff request made when opening an FR*LE2 station in the user's own authorized Charge E-Lec session and identify the white-label direct retail endpoint.
safeRoutesRemaining.constraint: No authentication bypass; use only an authorized user session.

safeRoutesRemaining.goal: Recover public archived JavaScript/configuration from pilote.charge-elec.leclerc to identify route and tenant structures.
safeRoutesRemaining.constraint: Architecture discovery only; never reuse historical prices.

safeRoutesRemaining.goal: Record current price per station/EVSE with timestamp where automatic access remains unavailable.
safeRoutesRemaining.constraint: Research evidence only unless freshness policy for TCC is explicitly accepted.

safeFallback: Keep Charge E-Lec rapid/ultra tariffs out of production TCC until a current direct SIPLEC tariff is resolved per station/EVSE.
